### Defining the Will of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/defining-will-god
Passage: Deuteronomy 29:29
Points:
- Believers often try to discover God's hidden future rather than what He has revealed.
- Scripture distinguishes between God's secret decrees and His revealed moral commands.
- The secret will of God governs all things sovereignly and can only be seen in retrospect.
- The revealed will of God provides moral guidance that displays what pleases Him.
- Faithful decision-making focuses on obeying God's Word rather than speculating about unknown plans.

### When We Don’t Have the Answers
Author: Tara Johnson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/when-we-don-t-have-the-answers-wholly-loved-october-25.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 29:29
Points:
- People often struggle when they lack answers to difficult questions in life.
- A father-son conversation on a plane shows that intimacy matters more than complete knowledge.
- God keeps certain things hidden while revealing what is necessary to follow Him.
- Believers are invited to rest in childlike trust and contentment with the Lord.
